title: network_flows
description: GENERATED by scripts/codegen.ts from contracts/ — do not edit. Run `npm run gen`.

event_id.description: Deterministic UUID (version 8, hash-derived) identifying the event. Used for deduplication.

event_ts.description: When the event happened, Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), ISO 8601 with millisecond precision and a Z suffix.

customer_id.description: Quandong customer code. MFW = Murray Flats Water (fictional).

site_id.description: Pump station (PS01 to PS40) or HO for head office.

feed.description: Name of the feed this event belongs to.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the contract the event was produced against.

generator_run_id.description: Identifier of the generator deployment (seed and configuration) that produced the event.

window_start.description: Start of the one-minute aggregation window (UTC, inclusive).

window_end.description: End of the one-minute aggregation window (UTC, exclusive).

src_asset_id.description: Source asset, or null when the source is not in the inventory (for example a remote access gateway client).

dst_asset_id.description: Destination asset, or null when not in the inventory.

dst_port.description: Destination Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) or User Datagram Protocol (UDP) port.

protocol.description: Application protocol identified by the sensor. OTHER when it could not be identified (for example a bare connection attempt).

bytes.description: Bytes transferred in both directions during the window.

packets.description: Packets transferred in both directions during the window.

direction.description: Direction relative to the site OT network.

connection_state.description: Outcome of the connection: established, rejected (reset or refused), or syn_only (no reply).
